issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers defines a method named appendElement(...) but Stock.java (template) and the solution use ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This name/signature mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from building and running the provided template code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent across the template and solution. Rename the template method appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) with the same signature used elsewhere (or change the calls in Stock.java to use appendElement). Ensure ArrayHelpers provides addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) so Stock.addToStockIngredients compiles and students can use the helper as intended.

issues.description: The ArrayHelpers helper method name is inconsistent between the template and the rest of the codebase: template_repository/src/.../ArrayHelpers.java defines appendElement(T[], T) but template_repository/src/.../Stock.java (and the solution) call addElementToArray(T[], T). This mismatch breaks the mapping between helper API described in the template and its usage in other classes, causing compilation errors and confusing students about the correct helper method to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the helper method name across artifacts. Rename template ArrayHelpers.appendElement(...) to addElementToArray(...) so it matches calls in Stock.java and the solution (or alternatively update Stock.java to call appendElement). Prefer using addElementToArray(...) to match the solution and existing usages.
